title: Cut subagent spend, now 47% of lead-session dollars
body:
Outcome: subagent dollars per merged PR fall measurably (cost-scan.py), by type and model, without more lead turns per PR.
Why: .krn/runs/roadmap-refill-2/tokens.md: since 2026-11-07 subagents cost $216 of $462 over 121 PRs; lead median $1.62 and 41 turns per PR.
Proof: `python3 -I .krn/runs/token-cost/cost-scan.py` before and after, split by subagent type.
Scope: this repository.

Measurement plan: before (2026-11-09) in .krn/runs/subagent-spend/before.txt: $216 subagents, $1.76/PR, 15 lanes >=100 turns = $167. Shipped maxTurns on krn-reader/krn-research plus lanes.md turn-budget rule. After: rerun `python3 -I .krn/runs/subagent-spend/split-scan.py` once ~30 PRs of new sessions exist; success = subagent $/PR below $1.2 and agents >=100 turns below 5.

Measured 2026-11-09: general-purpose = 99% of subagent $; 15 lanes >=100 turns = $166.86. Shipped krn-lane (maxTurns 90) routing. Replay cap 90: $223 -> $132 upper bound. After-run pending; see .krn/runs/subagent-spend/report.md
